beginner.summary: For system administrators, developers and DevOps trainees who have used a Linux terminal but have not run Nginx in production. Covers installation, the configuration hierarchy, server blocks, location matching, static files, logging, redirects and rewrites, compression and cache headers, a first reverse proxy, HTTPS with OpenSSL and Let's Encrypt, request limits, variables and map, Docker, basic hardening, error diagnosis and a two-site HTTPS capstone.
prerequisites: Comfortable with the Linux command line, file permissions and a text editor such as vim or nano
Understands HTTP requests, status codes and headers at a basic level and can use curl
Has a Linux VM, WSL or container host with sudo rights and ports 80 and 443 free
outcomes: Install, configure, test and reload Nginx safely with nginx -t and nginx -s reload
Host several sites with server blocks, location rules, static file handling and custom error pages
Proxy requests to an application backend over HTTPS with correct headers and certificates
Diagnose 403, 404, 502 and 504 responses from the error log and fix them
